title: Brazilian company pages: CNPJ and company name only (P250)
notes: Batch p2-G14-2, module pivots_brazil (static links). Rule 4 (legal floor): no template ever takes a CPF and no person-name or people-search template exists in this pack; CNPJ and company types only (P250 cond 9). CNPJ templates are privacy=true (frozen P311 lint: company identifiers), so they render for analyst-typed CNPJ seeds of a case that opted in. Order (P250 cond 6): Portal da Transparencia, Reclame Aqui, consumidor.gov.br, Jusbrasil, Escavador, Receita, Sintegra, Casa dos Dados (CCC/SVRS now needs a login and REDESIM/juntas have no stable value URL: not shipped).
